currentParagraphText: “I see,” Jake said, nodding, hoping that his Bow of the Apex Hunter would find new life once more with the help of Nature’s Attendant. The system-given bow from way back in the Treasure Hunt still had the best damn enchant he’d ever seen on any weapon, and it just fit Jake perfectly. Definitely by design, as the system had made it specifically for him.
